f.n: Walker Bay Whale Sanctuary Marine Protected Area
f.pu: To provide an important refuge for southern right whales and their calves to rest from July to November. The MPA protects rocky and sandy shore habitats and kelp forests immediately offshore that provide refuge for overexploited abalone and west coast rock lobster.
f.re: From July 1 to November 30: 1. No person shall without permission fish or attempt to fish; 2. No person shall, except on the authority of a permit, operate any boat, vessel or craft of any kind within the Whale Sanctuary Area.
